revision_history.v1_invalidation_stage: preflight before any target checkpoint or response acquisition completed
revision_history.v1_invalidation_reason: TorchQuantum MNIST ignored manifest data_seed for record selection, producing six identical candidate pools.
revision_history.v2_change: Use six explicit, source-disjoint partitions of the filtered canonical MNIST training corpus; no attack, endpoint, channel, or screening-gate change.

objective: Test whether controlled quantum execution responses contain membership information beyond fixed-channel loss and the existing prediction-vector-plus-statistics learned MIA.

provenance.execution: local Qiskit Aer simulation with the frozen IBM-derived noise snapshot; no real-hardware jobs

standard_prediction_api.access: known candidate label and repeated final probability vectors under one fixed serving layout

quantum_cloud_counts.access: known candidate label, raw bitstring counts, and permission to choose between two fixed physical initial layouts at the same total shot budget

threat_models.interpretation_boundary: Any raw-count or layout-probing advantage applies to the quantum-cloud-counts model, not automatically to a probability-only prediction API.

mnist_partition_protocol.class_balance: exactly balanced over digits 0,1,3,8 in every split

study_population.candidate_identity: SHA-256 of float32 candidate tensor bytes, shape, and class label
study_population.identity_safeguard: For every victim/calibration fold, attack-training candidates sharing a content identity with either held target are removed. Repeated auxiliary identities are averaged to one training row.

attack_model.feature_scaling: StandardScaler fit on attack-training targets only

evaluation.fold: leave one victim target and one distinct same-cell calibration target out; train on the remaining four targets
evaluation.loss_conditioning: 20 auxiliary-feature quantile bins; weighted within-bin victim AUC, requiring both membership classes per retained bin
evaluation.uncertainty: paired target bootstrap stratified by structural cell

feature_hierarchy.loss_mia: true-class probability from ten layout-A queries
feature_hierarchy.learned_mia: layout-A mean prediction vector plus loss, entropy, confidence, margin, and correctness
feature_hierarchy.classical_stochastic_control: learned-MIA features plus dispersion from ten class-multinomial draws matched to 128 shots
feature_hierarchy.fixed_marginal: learned-MIA features plus layout-A Pauli-Z mean and dispersion
feature_hierarchy.fixed_joint: fixed_marginal plus the aggregate layout-A 64-outcome bitstring distribution and pairwise Z covariance
feature_hierarchy.paired_probability_probe: five layout-A and five layout-B final-probability responses, their dispersion, and channel differences
feature_hierarchy.paired_marginal_probe: paired_probability_probe plus per-layout Pauli-Z marginals and differences
feature_hierarchy.paired_joint_probe: paired_marginal_probe plus per-layout 64-outcome distributions and pairwise Z covariance differences
feature_hierarchy.clean_z_diagnostic: exact probability-vector statistics plus exact Pauli-Z marginals; privileged diagnostic only

quantum_mechanism.rule: At least one of fixed_joint - learned_mia or paired_joint_probe - fixed_joint must have mean AUC difference at least 0.005 and positive AUC difference on at least four targets.

screening_gate.decision: Continue to an extended quantum-channel-probing study only if every gate passes. Otherwise stop treating quantum stochasticity/channel probing as a candidate stronger-MIA mechanism.

method_change_rule: Any feature, target, channel, attack-model, endpoint, threshold, or gate change after the lock requires a new protocol version and is exploratory relative to this Q0 screen.
